description: This file defines the IUserService interface for user-related operations in the TaskFlow.Api.Services.Interfaces namespace, including methods for retrieving users by ID and fetching all users.

classes.name: IUserService
classes.description: Interface for user service operations, including methods to get user details by ID and retrieve all users.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user by their unique identifier, returning null if user not found.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of all users.
